Mod Avenue: Excellent Value, Stylish Stay, and Surprisingly Good Food
My recent stay at Mod Avenue was fantastic, offering a compelling blend of style, comfort, and value. For anyone looking for accommodation in the ₹2500 price range, this hotel is definitely a top contender and highly recommended.
The first thing that stood out was the very good interior design. The aesthetic choices throughout the property give the hotel a premium feel that often costs much more. This attention to detail extended right into the rooms. I found my room to be surprisingly spacious, offering plenty of room to relax and work comfortably. Crucially, the hygiene was impeccably maintained—everything felt fresh and clean, which is essential for a worry-free stay.
One of the unexpected highlights was the food service. Often, in-room dining can be overpriced or underwhelming, but at Mod Avenue, I was pleasantly surprised. The food prices were well within a reasonable range, and the quality was genuinely good. I especially enjoyed the simple comfort food I tried—both the Maggi and the noodles were prepared perfectly.
Overall, Mod Avenue provides exceptional value for money. It couples a stylish environment with clean, comfortable rooms and high-quality, reasonably priced dining, making it a stellar choice in its price segment.
